string.value: One key per provider, stored only in this device's secure storage and never uploaded. Before saving, a minimal request checks that it works. Pick the model at chat time.

string.value: A privacy-first health chat app. Cloud inference runs on your own API key (BYOK); keys stay on this device only.

string.value: On-device models aren't wired up on HarmonyOS yet. Turn on "Deep thinking" to handle this message via the cloud (BYOK).
